_README: Declared implementation status per module, read by eval/harness.py (report block `implementation`) and pinned by tests/test_implementation_status.py. STUB must agree with the module's `stub = True` flag; PARTIAL lists what the spec requires that is NOT built, so a measurement can never be read as covering it; IMPLEMENTED means every spec deliverable exists (it still says nothing about correctness - that is what the measurement is for). `expected_skipped_tests` is the exact set of behaviour tests that are allowed to be skipped in the module's test_unit.py; any other skip fails the suite. `preconditions` name what a machine needs for the behaviour tests to RUN rather than skip. Sources: AI/docs/audit/MODULE_CONTRACTS.md, MODULE_MAP.md (2026-09-17). Owners update this file with their module (docs/team/README.md).
